L02.why: Verb-agreement/tense set; any could fit depending on subject and time

L03.why: Expletive 'it' cannot be what an opening modifier describes

L13.why: Gerund subject unlikely to match an opening modifier about the chef

L14.why: Punctuation set; any could fit depending on what follows

L15.why: Participle may leave sentence without main verb

L16.why: Lone comma separates subject from verb trip

L17.why: Subject pronoun 'he' likely follows a preposition here

L18.why: Plural 'stocks' with singular 'stays' if stocks is subject

L19.why: Shift to second person 'you' rarely fits SAT prose

L20.why: Single comma splits compound subject from verb

L22.why: 'that one anticipates' breaks parallelism in most frames
